steps.say: A funnel narrows a whole market down, stage by stage, and keeps the list up to date every hour.
Open Funnels. | Angstrom's Trend funnel is ready to copy: the pool at the top, then each stage narrowing it down.
Choose the market and direction, then make your own copy.
At the top of the funnel, the pool: here, the top one hundred coins by market cap.
Each stage asks one question on its own chart. | Drag a Set onto a stage to change it, even one of your own.
Save and activate. | It's checked straight away, then every hour.
Your funnel shows as Dynamic funnel above the signal tables, with alerts on new Candidates.
